verdict.rationale: Gram generates and hosts MCP servers from OpenAPI/Functions sources and explicitly markets 'Point Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot at one URL' with SSO, policy, and audit built in, meaning developers connect to a hosted endpoint without deploying infrastructure themselves. It also supports proxying third-party MCP servers behind a governed hosted endpoint, reinforcing the no-deploy remote-URL model. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs and no explicit latency/uptime SLAs for the hosted endpoint.
